hook: He and his dog Lucky were stuck in a flood.
narration: He and his dog Lucky rode this basket up out of a flooded neighborhood.
Hurricane Florence had put the streets north of the Cape Fear River underwater.
They had climbed from their van onto a roof.
A Coast Guard crew from Elizabeth City sent a rescuer down the cable.
The flight mechanic runs the hoist and talks the pilots in, since they can't see below.
outcome: The crew brought the man and Lucky up off that roof together.
title: Man and his dog Lucky saved from a roof
description:
After Hurricane Florence, Coast Guard aircrews from Air Station Elizabeth City rescued a man and his dog Lucky off a rooftop north of the Cape Fear River, North Carolina, on Sept. 17, 2018.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Elizabeth City, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/626424/air-station-elizabeth-city-saves-man-and-his-dog-lucky-roof
